answer: A pre-written answer bank therefore goes stale within one epoch, and reusing one text across 30 aliases trips the duplicate check at the mirror gate. The dune receipt proves which words were live for that identity, and the audit replays it against the seed. Sustaining that many identities means writing fresh texts against a target that moves every epoch, which means the work cannot be batched or cached in advance. That is 3 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
